title: query_ward_risk
description: Fetch the 06:00 AM NPT 5-pillar fused epidemiological risk, WHO/EDCD indices (HI, CI, BI, PPI), NASADEM elevation viability (V_elev), and Bikram Sambat date for a Nepal ward.

composite_ward_id.description: Canonical Nepal 4-tier composite ward ID (e.g., 'NP-P3-D27-30608-W17' for Kathmandu Metro Ward 17 Chhetrapati).
